chapters.title: 1.	Prologue: The Scream Beneath the Earth
A prelude to horror—introducing the primordial cry and the creeping crimson mist that herald the coming nightmare.
Margaret Sloane’s first encounter with the unnatural fissure and the oozing terror beneath Haven’s Hollow.
Discovery of a cursed relic that binds fate to an ancient cosmic horror.
The night of abject terror—when familiar faces become grotesque, and the town succumbs to inexplicable violence.
5.	Chapter 4: The Congregation of the Damned
An eerie assembly under a blood-red sky where unholy rites and twisted incantations tear at the soul of the town.
The transformation of Haven’s Hollow into a battleground between mortal frailty and a monstrous, incarnate evil.
A desperate glimpse into the ancient prophecy and the dark truth behind the cursed pendant.
8.	Chapter 7: Sacrificial Rites and Crimson Oaths
A brutal ceremony of blood and terror, awakening a pact with forces older than time.
Demonic forces infiltrate human bodies, transforming once-familiar souls into instruments of unspeakable horror.
The unleashing of grotesque abominations, as ancient demons claw their way into the living world.
Mirrors become portals to nightmarish visions, reflecting twisted realities and silent, eternal screams.
A desperate ritual binds the souls of the damned in a pact with a force that promises endless torment.
The apocalypse of Haven’s Hollow unfolds as the fabric of reality is torn asunder leaving a cliffhanger that portends greater horrors to come.
